groups.caution: Sequential batch; excludes filling, cleaning and operator delays; recovery is a lumped allowance.
Product mass and elemental aluminium are different bases; effective dose needs jar testing.
Fluid power is not motor demand, impeller speed or local floc shear.
No concentration measurements; flux/permeance assumptions do not predict rejection or durability.
Linear permeance extrapolation neglects losses; not a validated low-pressure flux prediction.
Sampled trajectories may be integrated by trapezoids; none are supplied as experimental data.
Uniform field and plug flow; assumed fluence is not a universal safety threshold or validated dose.
Energy per m^3 pumped, not full treatment energy per delivered volume.
Matching organism/assay basis is required; a nondetect is not zero; no BLUESHIELD removal is calculated.

note: Equations are implemented; only supplied illustrative scenarios are calculated.
